method: Expected facts checked against parsed source passages; selected Visa pages previously checked visually
decisions: Score expected facts by meaning rather than exact wording.
Clarification, conflict disclosure and source limitations are useful correct behaviours.
E09 no longer supplies the deadline numbers in its question: retrieval must find the conflict.
E10 separates combining documents from the one-file limit: the short passage cannot support both facts.
Relevant passage coverage and sufficient support are separate metrics; redundant alternatives need not all be retrieved for a correct answer.
Matching citation IDs alone do not prove claim support; inspect the actual text.
Unsupported guarantees, invented facts and provider/corpus leakage are errors.
evaluation_provenance: Small assistant-authored and assistant-reviewed synthetic development set. Separate holdout cases must be reserved before tuning.
